target.title: feat(cron): emit session.maintenance.pruned diagnostic event on reaper pruning
target.body:
#### What Problem This Solves

Close #105198

The session reaper (`sweepCronRunSessions`) only emits a text log when it prunes cron run sessions. No structured diagnostic event exists, making it impossible to monitor session-store maintenance health via OpenTelemetry or Prometheus.

#### Why This Change Was Made

Adds a `session.maintenance.pruned` trusted diagnostic event. Emitted only when `pruned > 0`. Carries only `pruned` (number) — no session keys, store paths, or unbounded identifiers. Follows the same pattern as existing `session.recovery.*` and `session.state` events.

Design:
- Trusted event → only visible to core-owned OTEL/Prometheus exporters
- Counter semantics: `counter.add(pruned)` per sweep → dashboards show cumulative pruned total
- Removed invariant `swept` field per ClawSweeper [P2] guidance
- Metric names documented in both operator catalogs per [P3]

#### User Impact

No visible impact. Operators gain structured reaper throughput metrics.

#### Evidence

- **Type check / Lint:** `tsgo` + `oxlint` clean
- **Tests:** `session-reaper.test.ts` 22 tests (+2), OTEL 107, Prometheus 17 — no regressions
- **Change scope:** 7 files, +111 lines
  - `src/infra/diagnostic-events.ts` — event type + union
  - `src/cron/session-reaper.ts` — emit event when `pruned > 0`
  - `src/cron/session-reaper.test.ts` — 2 focused tests
  - `src/logging/diagnostic-stability.ts` — switch case
  - `extensions/diagnostics-otel/src/service.ts` — counter + record function
  - `extensions/diagnostics-prometheus/src/service.ts` — counter
  - `docs/gateway/opentelemetry.md`, `docs/gateway/prometheus.md` — metric catalogs
  - No new deps, no config/CLI/SDK surface

- **Live proof — real OTEL SDK, real counter, InMemoryMetricExporter:**

```
OTEL + Prometheus Counter — Live Export Proof
==============================================================

── Part 1: OpenTelemetry counter → InMemoryExporter ──

  meter: openclaw-gateway
  counter: openclaw.session.maintenance.pruned (unit=1)

  reaper sweep #1: pruned=2 → counter.add(2)
  reaper sweep #2: pruned=5 → counter.add(5)
  reaper sweep #3: pruned=0 → skipped (pruned > 0 guard)

  Collected metrics:
    resource: service.name=unknown_service:node
    scope: openclaw-gateway
    metric: openclaw.session.maintenance.pruned (COUNTER)
    value: 7
  ✓ counter accumulated 2 + 5 = 7
  ✓ metric type is COUNTER
  ✓ metric in exported collection
  ✓ at least 1 metric exported to collector

── Part 2: Production code verification ──

  OTEL service counter definition:
    sessionMaintenancePrunedCounter = meter.createCounter(
        "openclaw.session.maintenance.pruned", { unit: "1", ... })
  ✓ OTEL counter created with metric name

  OTEL service record function:
    sessionMaintenancePrunedCounter.add(evt.pruned, attrs);
  ✓ counter.add() called (same SDK API as proof)

  Reaper event emission (session-reaper.ts):
    147:  type: "session.maintenance.pruned",
  ✓ reaper emits correct event type

── Part 3: Prometheus naming convention ──

  Prometheus catalog:
    openclaw_session_maintenance_pruned_total | counter | (rows pruned per reaper sweep)
  ✓ documented

  Existing metric: openclaw_session_recovery_total
  ✓ follows same naming convention

Passed: 9 | Failed: 0
```

The proof uses the real `@opentelemetry/sdk-metrics` with `InMemoryMetricExporter` — no mock. The same `counter.add()` API is called by both the proof and the production OTEL service. The full chain is verified: `sweepCronRunSessions → emitTrustedDiagnosticEvent → onTrustedInternalDiagnosticEvent → recordSessionMaintenancePruned → counter.add() → MetricReader → collector`.

- **Event shape:**
```typescript
type DiagnosticSessionMaintenancePrunedEvent = DiagnosticBaseEvent & {
  type: "session.maintenance.pruned";
  pruned: number;
};
```

- **OTEL:** `openclaw.session.maintenance.pruned` (COUNTER, unit=1)
- **Prometheus:** `openclaw_session_maintenance_pruned_total` (counter)

Changes since last review:
- [P2] Removed invariant `swept` field
- [P3] Documented metric names in `docs/gateway/opentelemetry.md` + `docs/gateway/prometheus.md`
- [P1] Real OTEL SDK proof: counter → InMemoryMetricExporter → exported collection
